about: What scripts/dependencies.mjs allows. The project is GPL-3.0-only, so every dependency must be under a license a GPL-3.0 program may include, and come from the official registry. An exception names a dependency whose metadata says too little, with the license its own files state.

caniuse-lite.reason: Browser data that Vite reads at build time; it is not in the built app. The FSF lists CC-BY-4.0 as compatible with GPLv3.
